d: Chirag Paswan on Chhath Puja 2026 : kendriy mantri chirag pasvan ne chhath mahaparv ke avsar par deshvasiyon aur biharvasiyon ko dher sari shubhkamnaen din...unhonne kaha ki chhathi maiya ke aashirvad se unhonne jivan men bahut kuchh paya hai aur vah is parv ko pure shraddha bhav se manate hain...Chirag Paswan ne kaha ki chhath ke char din kaise bit jate hain, pata hi nahin chalta... unhonne kamna ki ki aane vala sal har kisi ke lie behtar ho, sabhi ki manokamnaen puri hon aur chhathi maiya ka aashirvad sab par bana rahe
